title: Total-cone comparison preserves canonical augmentation
statement: For a compatible pair of augmented arrows, the total-cone isomorphism [def-sc-preorder-bar-total-cone-iso] followed by the induced map between the cones of their total augmentations is the canonical augmentation of the cone-diagram bar [def-sc-preorder-bar-cone-diagram].

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: First prove that totalArrow commutes with augmentation by the general reindexing naturality theorem. Test the claimed cone equality on each bar generator and both cone inclusions. In horizontal degree zero the total augmentation is the cocone map on the coefficient, and the source comparison sign is 1. Both sides are then the same mappingCone.map. In positive horizontal degree the augmentation is zero, as follows from the zero component of the single column. These two cases prove the exact augmentation equality.

lean.statement:
lemma totalConeIso_augmentation (c : Cocone D) (e : Cocone E) (f : c.pt ⟶ e.pt)
    (hf : ∀ i, φ.app i ≫ e.ι.app i = c.ι.app i ≫ f) :
    (totalConeIso φ).hom ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCone.map (totalArrow φ) f
      (totalAugmentation D c) (totalAugmentation E e)
      (totalArrow_augmentation φ c e f hf) =
    totalAugmentation (coneDiagram φ) (coneCocone φ c e f hf)
